Capital Resources and Allocation At September 30, 2026, the Company had: • Cash and cash equivalents of $147.5 million • Availability of approximately $227.0 million under the Company's $600.0 million senior secured revolving credit facility (due 2031) • Term Loan B facility with outstanding balance of $485.0 million (due 2030) • Senior unsecured notes totaling $541.0 million at 4.625 percent (due 2028) During the quarter, the Company completed the refinancing and upsizing of its revolver, replacing the previous revolver and Term Loan A with a new five-year $600 million revolving credit facility, due in 2031. In addition, the Company reduced its debt balance by $52.8 million, including payments of $43.8 million under the senior secured credit facility and $9.0 million of senior unsecured notes repurchased at a discount. There were no repurchases of the Company's common stock during the quarter; approximately $923 million remained available for repurchases under the Company's stock repurchase plan. Fourth Quarter 2026 Financial Estimates The Company's financial estimates for the fourth quarter of 2026, which are set forth below, are based on current market conditions and assume no deterioration in the markets served. Reconciliations of estimated net income to the estimated non-GAAP financial measures are included in the tables that accompany this release.
